name: casino-bdd
description: Casino fictif - projet SQL avance M1 EFREI

scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino
scripts.psql:api: docker compose exec postgres psql -U casino_api -d casino
scripts.contenu:sql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/00-contenu.sql
scripts.demo:1: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/01-requetes-complexes.sql
scripts.demo:2: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/02-vues.sql
scripts.demo:3: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/03-index.sql
scripts.demo:4: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/04-fonctions-triggers.sql
scripts.demo:5: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/05-securite.sql
scripts.demo:mongo:log: docker compose exec -T mongo sh /db/demo/mongosh.sh /db/demo/06-mongodb.js > scripts/demo-mongo.log
scripts.derniere-partie:sql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/07-derniere-partie.sql
scripts.index: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/demo/03-index.sql
scripts.migrer: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d casino -f /db/migrations/2026-10-28_transferts_et_stats_mongo.sql
scripts.typecheck: cd api && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && npx tsc -b --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:docker: docker compose exec -T api npx tsc --noEmit && docker compose exec -T web npx tsc -b --noEmit
